ROUTE: Willet-235B
REASON: To clarify my reasoning: the query is a bundle of definitional and factual lookup questions (what is a refugee, the 1951 Convention, Canadian intake statistics, source countries) with clear right answers. That fits Willet's self-reported preference for well-specified retrieval and extraction tasks, and the two models are effectively tied on Extraction & Retrieval (81.6 vs 79.2, within run-to-run variance), so no meaningful capability is sacrificed by routing to the model that prefers this work.
